name: 05 — Gateway Rate Limit (API 10/min)
description:
Tests API rate limiting enforcement. Sends 15 requests in quick succession.

🔧 Gateway Config:
• Token: test-gateway-token-12345
• NO app assigned → Direct path
• Tenant Quota (payops_ai):
  - API requests per minute: 10
  - Enforcement: Redis INCR (1-min window)
  - Key: rl:them:{tenant_id}:api:{minute}
  - TTL: 90 seconds

📊 Expected Result:
• Requests 1-10: ✅ 200 OK (Success)
• Requests 11-15: ❌ 429 Too Many Requests
• Error: "quota exceeded"

🔍 Verifies:
• Rate limit blocking works
• 429 error returned correctly
• Redis counter increments
• Subsequent minute resets counter

✅ Purpose: Prove API rate limiting blocks requests after crossing 10/min limit.
